long_biography.plain_text:
Rosenblum joined his family's photography group after business school and, with his brother Steve, used its photo-processing operation to test online commerce. They shifted from digital photo development to selling cameras and electronics, turning Pixmania into a pan-European retailer. In 2006 they sold a majority stake at a €345 million valuation.

After leaving the original group, Rosenblum founded smartphone-accessories retailer The Kase and made technology investments. He later returned to Pixmania with Steve and relaunched the brand around new and refurbished connected devices. As chief executive, he now combines its online marketplace with an in-house refurbishment laboratory, financing and repair services.
